expectation.note: With WKST defaulting to MO, the weekly period is Mon-Sun and the last of {Mon,Wed,Fri} is Friday. DTSTART 2026-01-05 is a Monday and is NOT in the set, so this vector also probes DTSTART emission.

normative_evidence.quote: BYSETPOS ... specify the nth occurrence within the set of recurrence instances specified by the rule ... corresponding to the last day of the week

rationale: BYSETPOS interacts with WKST through the definition of the period; few engines test this combination.
title: BYSETPOS with FREQ=WEEKLY (a period with at most 7 candidates)
